D1.title: Quantum A_c Formula Contains Fatal Constant Artifact
D1.description: The I component in quantum A_c v1.0 is I = n_states × 256 = 8192, a constant determined entirely by Hilbert space dimension. It does not measure dynamical instability — it measures circuit width. This explains why A_c = 1641.876 was identical across all messages ('Peace.Love.789', 'Hello World', 'Quantum Cloud-9', random strings). The 'discovery' was a mathematical artifact.
D1.impact: All quantum hardware validation must HALT until formula is redesigned. Previous quantum A_c claims are INVALID.
D1.action: Redesigned as A_c v3.0 with I_q = log(PR)/log(n_states) — participation ratio, actually dynamic.

D2.title: TNG A_c is Mass-Dominated, Not Complexity-Sensitive
D2.description: Across 100 TNG100-1 halos, A_c shows no statistically significant difference between quiescent and active halos (v1: p=0.224, v2.1: p=0.551). The U-shaped mass trend, exponential v2.1 rise at M>10^13 M_sun, and near-identical component breakdowns between inliers/outliers all indicate that A_c is primarily measuring halo mass, not intrinsic complexity. The 'quiescent deficit' hypothesis is falsified.
D2.impact: Quiescent halo deficit hypothesis ABANDONED. Must pivot to dynamical hypothesis.
D2.action: Redesigned as Merger-Evolution Hypothesis: dA_c/dt = Γ_merge × ΔA_c_merge - A_c/τ_relax

D3.title: Counter-Intuitive Merger-Formation Relationship: Earlier Formation → Lower Present-Day A_c
D3.description: Analysis of A_c vs formation redshift reveals a NEGATIVE correlation (slope ~-0.18 per unit z). Halos that formed earlier (higher z) have LOWER present-day A_c. This contradicts the naive expectation that more time = more complexity. Instead, it suggests complexity is CREATED by mergers and DESTROYED by relaxation over cosmic time. Early-forming halos have had more time for relaxation to erase merger-induced structure.

evidence.interpretation: Relaxation/phase-mixing erases complexity faster than passive evolution creates it

D3.impact: Supports the merger-evolution hypothesis. Suggests A_c is a dynamical tracer, not a static property.
D3.action: Formalize as CREATE-DESTROY model; test with merger tree tracking.

D4.title: Spatial Clustering of Low-A_c Halos Suggests Environmental Suppression
D4.description: 25 low-A_c halos cluster at low cm_x coordinates, while 9 spatial outliers appear at high cm_x. After mass detrending, low-intrinsic-complexity halos remain clustered spatially. One extreme outlier at (75000, 26200) ckpc/h shows very low intrinsic A_c, possibly a tidally stripped or backsplash halo. This suggests environment affects complexity independently of mass.

evidence.mass_detrended_residuals: Low A_c residuals remain spatially clustered

D4.impact: Environmental context must be included in A_c formula. Pure halo-internal properties are insufficient.
D4.action: Add E_env (environmental context) and T_dyn (dynamical age) corrections to A_c formula.

D5.title: Unified 'Baseline Dominance' Failure Mode Across Quantum and Cosmology
D5.description: Both quantum and cosmological A_c failures share the same root cause: the formula measures a dominant baseline property rather than the intended signal. In quantum, the baseline is circuit width (I = constant). In cosmology, the baseline is mass (A_c ∝ M). The fix is identical in both domains: measure DEVIATION from equilibrium, not absolute magnitude. This suggests a universal design principle for complexity metrics.
D5.impact: Provides a cross-domain validation criterion for all future A_c variants. Any component that is constant or monotonic with a baseline property is suspect.
D5.action: Apply 'deviation from equilibrium' principle to all future A_c implementations (biology, medicine, materials).

D6.title: Personal Genomics as Strongest Empirical Anchor (Score 0.802, Layer 1)
D6.description: Among all 9 sandbox entries in this batch, the AncestryDNA analysis is the only Layer 1 (Established Physics) entry with HIGH confidence. The compound MTHFR variant (rs1801131 A1298C + rs1801133 C677T + rs2274976) showing ~60% enzyme activity is clinically actionable via methylfolate supplementation. This demonstrates that Cloud-9 CAN produce solid empirical results when applied to well-characterized domains.
D6.impact: Validates Cloud-9 framework's ability to identify actionable empirical findings. Suggests biological/medical domains may be more productive than cosmology/quantum for near-term results.
D6.action: Integrate genomics with microbiome + CGM for personal biological complexity time series. Prioritize biological applications.

D8.title: K-Dwarf Intelligence Lead Model: 61 Cygni A Leads Earth by 3.5 Gyr
D8.description: The K-dwarf convergence model estimates intelligence maturity leads for nearby K-type stars. 61 Cygni A (11.4 ly, ~6+ Gyr old, low flare rate) leads Earth by ~3.5 billion years in stable biosphere evolution window. While untestable on human timescales, the astrophysical arguments (longer MS lifetimes, lower flare activity) are sound. This provides a SETI prioritization framework.
